comparison.objective: Install a rack bracket, versus place setting blocks and glaze a window frame.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual elongated-part alignment is shared generically, but the PR requires staged block placement and vertical lowering of fragile glass without sill contact.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket locked and clear versus glass standing on both correctly placed blocks, centred and released, with any sill touch invalidating the run.
comparison.reason: The staged support preparation and fragile-contact constraint test a materially different ability.
